Name: Piram, King of Jarmuth
Summary: Piram was king of Jarmuth and one of the five kings who allied against Gibeon and were defeated by Joshua.
KeyStory: Piram joined Adoni-zedek against Gibeon, fled to the cave at Makkedah, and was hanged with the other four kings.
LifeLesson: Alliances against God end in the same cave.
